model_binding.oos_skill: spearman_ic of held-out names versus next-session residual return
model_binding.weight_rule: an expanding walk-forward Spearman skill of held-out fit_fusion_model scores versus next-session residual returns must be strictly above oos_skill_threshold before sizing; otherwise the book is cash. A rebalance with no completed pre-decision label is also cash. When the gate passes, positive scores share max_gross_leverage in proportion to score, each name capped at max_position_weight, then scaled so post-cost gross leverage stays inside the cap

description: Software ledger for the locked barebone-comparison-v1 window 2025-01-02 through 2026-01-12, rebalanced every 10 sessions. Prices are the local Yahoo Finance tape after scaling OHLC by Adj Close over Close. The tape starts on the window start, so a rebalance with no completed pre-decision label stays in cash. No price is filled. LLM arms use the desk's first orchestrator seal. Fusion uses the pre-window calibration artifact and still requires a market head. Pure ML sizes a multi-name book only after an expanding walk-forward out-of-sample skill check on held-out names. Non-positive skill leaves that rebalance in cash. When the gate passes, positive walk-forward scores share the gross budget under the locked position and gross caps. Market-approved fusion uses the same score book without that skill gate. QQQ is a secondary price index on the metrics file, not a tradable name. This is not a performance claim.

market_data.adjustment: raw OHLC plus Yahoo Finance Adj Close via yfinance; no second adjustment is applied
market_data.disclaimer: not redistributed; local bind only. Yahoo Finance data is not for trading purposes and is not redistributed.
